points.title: 贵族少年
points.description: 雪莱出生于英格兰苏塞克斯郡的一个古老贵族家庭，父亲是议员，祖父是男爵。在伊顿公学接受教育期间，他展现出对科学的浓厚兴趣和对传统权威的反抗精神。这一时期他开始阅读启蒙思想家的著作，特别是卢梭的作品，形成了自由主义和激进的政治观点。1809年，他与好友霍格共同创办了《短命期刊》，发表激进思想，这成为他早期政治思想的体现。
points.descriptionEn: Shelley was born into an ancient aristocratic family in Sussex, England, with his father being a Member of Parliament and his grandfather a baron. At Eton College, he developed a strong interest in science and a rebellious attitude toward traditional authority. During this period, he began reading works of Enlightenment thinkers, particularly Rousseau, forming liberal and radical political views. In 1809, he co-founded the short-lived journal 'The Necessity of Atheism' with his friend Hogg, publishing radical ideas that reflected his early political thinking.

points.title: 思想觉醒
points.description: 雪莱进入牛津大学大学学院学习，但很快因发表《无神论的必然性》小册子被开除。这一事件导致他与家庭关系破裂，也标志着他公开挑战宗教权威的决心。1812年，他前往爱尔兰支持天主教解放运动，发表《告爱尔兰人民书》，呼吁爱尔兰人民反抗英国统治。同年，他与16岁的哈丽特·韦斯特布鲁克结婚，但这段婚姻并不幸福，为日后的生活埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Shelley entered University College, Oxford, but was soon expelled for publishing his pamphlet 'The Necessity of Atheism.' This event caused a rift with his family and marked his determination to challenge religious authority openly. In 1812, he traveled to Ireland to support Catholic emancipation, publishing 'An Address to the Irish People' and calling for Irish resistance to British rule. The same year, he married 16-year-old Harriet Westbrook, but the marriage was unhappy, laying the groundwork for future difficulties.

points.title: 流亡生活
points.description: 雪莱与妻子哈丽特关系恶化后，于1814年与玛丽·戈德温（后来的玛丽·雪莱）私奔，前往欧洲大陆旅行。他们拜访了拜伦等人，这段经历对雪莱的创作产生了深远影响。1816年，哈丽特自杀后，雪莱与玛丽正式结婚。这一时期他创作了《麦布女王》等政治性长诗，表达了对社会不平等的强烈批判。由于激进的政治观点，雪莱被社会排斥，经济状况拮据，但创作力旺盛，形成了独特的浪漫主义诗歌风格。
points.descriptionEn: After his relationship with Harriet deteriorated, Shelley eloped with Mary Godwin (later Mary Shelley) in 1814, traveling across continental Europe. They met figures like Byron, an experience that profoundly influenced Shelley's work. Following Harriet's suicide in 1816, Shelley married Mary formally. During this period, he wrote political long poems like 'Queen Mab,' expressing strong criticism of social inequality. Due to his radical political views, Shelley was ostracized by society and faced financial difficulties, but his creativity flourished, developing a distinctive Romantic poetic style.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 雪莱移居意大利，与拜伦等人成为好友，度过了一段相对平静的创作时期。在意大利，他创作了《西风颂》、《致云雀》等著名抒情诗，以及《解放了的普罗米修斯》等哲学诗剧。这一时期他的诗歌风格更加成熟，融合了政治激进性与哲学深度。雪莱在意大利广泛阅读哲学和科学著作，特别是受威廉·戈德温和柏拉图思想影响，形成了独特的乌托邦社会理想。他与玛丽的生活相对稳定，但仍然面临经济困难和家庭悲剧。
points.descriptionEn: Shelley moved to Italy, becoming friends with Byron and others, spending a relatively peaceful period of creativity. In Italy, he wrote famous lyric poems like 'Ode to the West Wind' and 'To a Skylark,' as well as philosophical dramas like 'Prometheus Unbound.' During this time, his poetic style matured, blending political radicalism with philosophical depth. Shelley extensively read philosophy and science in Italy, particularly influenced by William Godwin and Plato, forming unique utopian social ideals. His life with Mary was relatively stable, but he still faced financial difficulties and family tragedies.

points.title: 英年早逝
points.description: 雪莱在意大利莱里切海岸生活，继续创作和翻译工作。1822年7月8日，他在海上航行时遭遇风暴，小船沉没，不幸溺水身亡，年仅29岁。雪莱的早逝震惊了文学界，他的遗体被火化，心脏被玛丽保存。他的死使他成为浪漫主义运动的传奇人物，象征着天才的短暂与永恒。雪莱去世后，他的作品逐渐被重新评价，对维多利亚时代的文学产生了深远影响，成为后世自由思想和反抗精神的象征。
points.descriptionEn: Shelley lived on the coast of Lerici, Italy, continuing his writing and translation work. On July 8, 1822, he drowned at sea when his boat sank in a storm, dying at the age of only 29. Shelley's early death shocked the literary world; his body was cremated, and his heart was preserved by Mary. His death made him a legendary figure of the Romantic movement, symbolizing the brevity and eternity of genius. After his death, Shelley's works were gradually re-evaluated, profoundly influencing Victorian literature and becoming a symbol of later liberal thought and the spirit of rebellion.

supporter.zh: 雪莱被视为英国浪漫主义诗歌的先驱和革命思想的象征。他的诗歌充满激情与想象力，对自然、自由和美的追求超越了时代局限。作为一位坚定的政治激进主义者，他反对专制、宗教压迫和社会不平等，倡导和平与改革。雪莱的作品，特别是《解放了的普罗米修斯》，体现了人类精神追求自由与解放的永恒主题，激励了后世无数追求社会正义的改革者。
supporter.en: Shelley is regarded as a pioneer of British Romantic poetry and a symbol of revolutionary thought. His poetry, filled with passion and imagination, transcends the limitations of his time in its pursuit of nature, freedom, and beauty. As a steadfast political radical, he opposed tyranny, religious oppression, and social inequality, advocating peace and reform. His works, particularly 'Prometheus Unbound,' embody the eternal theme of humanity's spiritual quest for freedom and liberation, inspiring countless reformers seeking social justice throughout history.

critic.zh: 批评者认为雪莱的生活混乱且不负责任，他抛弃发妻的行为受到道德谴责。他的诗歌被认为过于抽象和理论化，缺乏具体的社会实践指导。雪莱的政治理想被批评为不切实际的乌托邦主义，忽视了人性的复杂性和社会变革的困难。此外，他的无神论立场在当时被视为极端和危险，导致他被主流社会排斥。批评者指出，雪莱虽然才华横溢，但缺乏将理想转化为现实的能力和耐心。
critic.en: Critics argue that Shelley's life was chaotic and irresponsible, condemning his abandonment of his first wife. His poetry is seen as overly abstract and theoretical, lacking practical guidance for social change. Shelley's political ideals are criticized as unrealistic utopianism that ignores the complexity of human nature and the difficulties of social transformation. Additionally, his atheistic stance was considered extreme and dangerous in his time, leading to his exclusion from mainstream society. Critics note that while Shelley was immensely talented, he lacked the ability and patience to translate his ideals into reality.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，雪莱被定义为浪漫主义运动的标志性人物，其影响力远超同时代许多作家。他的诗歌技巧和创新对后世文学产生了深远影响，特别是对现代主义诗歌的先驱们。雪莱的政治思想虽然在当时被视为激进，但预见了19世纪和20世纪的许多社会改革运动。在流行文化中，雪莱常被描绘为反叛天才的象征，他的早逝和浪漫悲剧人生使他成为永恒的文化偶像。他的作品持续被学者研究和重新诠释，反映了不同时代对社会、政治和人类精神的关注。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Shelley is defined as a seminal figure of the Romantic movement, whose influence extends far beyond many of his contemporaries. His poetic techniques and innovations have had a profound impact on later literature, particularly on pioneers of modernist poetry. Although his political views were considered radical in his time, they anticipated many social reform movements of the 19th and 20th centuries. In popular culture, Shelley is often depicted as a symbol of rebellious genius, and his early death and romantic tragic life have made him an eternal cultural icon. His works continue to be studied and reinterpreted by scholars, reflecting changing concerns about society, politics, and the human spirit across different eras.

self.zh: 诗人是世界未经承认的立法者。
self.en: Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world.

others.zh: 雪莱是我们这个时代最富诗意的灵魂之一，他的想象力如火焰般燃烧，照亮了黑暗的角落。
others.en: Shelley is one of the most poetic souls of our age, whose imagination burns like a flame, illuminating the darkest corners.
